dataList.content: ... I don’t want to embellish my motives saying it's for others.
I was doing it all for me.
For me, who's feeling sadder than anyone...
... It is possible that this is what the scenario was meant to show us.
... No one's going to cry on my behalf even if I'm sad.
If I must... carry this emotion, if I can't get rid of it...
Then I'll take the path of getting back on my feet with this sadness instead.
This power has to be an opportunity given to me.
